what_was_wrong: load_cell() read episodes under the key 'episodes' and fell back to [data] when absent. run_bandit_pv10_episodes.py writes them under 'runs'. The fallback therefore wrapped the ENTIRE cell payload as one pseudo-episode: the gate read n=1, C1=1.0000 over that single object, and C2/C3/C4 degenerate -> a spurious FAIL verdict. It did not raise; it silently produced a well-formed but meaningless result (fail-open).
what_was_changed: load_cell() only. Reads data['runs']; raises SystemExit when 'runs' is absent instead of guessing at the schema (fail-closed).
what_was_NOT_changed: the four criteria C1-C4 and their justifications
the prescreen basis, seed bank, order bank, module hashes
timing_disclosure: THE REPAIR HAPPENED AFTER THE DATA EXISTED. All three cells (a0, am4, ap4; 20 seeds each) were already on disk when the loader bug was found. This is disclosed rather than hidden: a reader must be able to see that the evaluator was touched post-hoc, and verify from the hashes above that only loading changed and no criterion moved.
why_the_freeze_did_not_catch_it: The manifest verifies the evaluator's HASH, not its correctness against the driver's actual output schema. No end-to-end test ever ran the evaluator over a real driver-written file. Freezing prevents tampering; it does not establish that the two halves were ever wired together.
remediation: test_pv10_gate_end_to_end.py: writes a payload in the driver's real schema, asserts the evaluator recovers every episode, and asserts a payload lacking 'runs' fails closed.
reporting_rule: The formal conclusion is ONLY: alpha=0 capability gate PASS. The +-4 PASS results are DESCRIPTIVE interface checks -- the gate is defined on the alpha=0 cell and was never a per-alpha criterion.
C4_interpretation_limit: C4 = .778 says the model usually commits to an arm inside its CURRENT empirical-best set. It is NOT a general 'evidence utilisation' measure, for two reasons: (a) ties make the set frequently larger than one arm, so the random reference is NOT strictly 1/K = .25 and the chance floor is higher than the stated .25; (b) the empirical-best set is produced by the model's OWN concentrated sampling, so agreeing with it is partly self-consistency, not external correctness. Report C4 as 'commits inside its own empirical-best set', never as evidence ability.
